accuracy_definition: A case passes when (1) retrieved document_ids include every expected_source_id, (2) if expect_refuse is true the answer is the grounded refuse sentence, otherwise every required_fact appears in the answer, and (3) the answer does not introduce numbers or document-like identifiers that are absent from retrieved context. This is evidence-based and measurable; it is not a claim of 100% accuracy.
